messages:
anya: quick thread: finalizing behavior for the first-run quickstart banner + sample templates. two design directions: compact banner with flyout vs full-page empty-state takeover. thoughts?
matt: leaning flyout. keeps console clean but still lets us show the checklist and 1-2 templates. less intimidating for new users.
judy: agree. accessibility concern: when the flyout opens keyboard focus must move into the container and trap until closed. focus order should be logical (close -> checklist -> CTA). also need visible focus outlines on all interactive elements.
ricardo: implementation note: we'll persist checklist.progress in user prefs and expose an endpoint for front-end to fetch. if user dismisses, set dismissed_quickstart_ttl to now + 7d. TTL approach avoids permanent loss while keeping storage minimal.
anya: copy decision: option A: "Complete setup  5 steps to go live" vs option B: "Finish setup  get to production". short and punchy preferred.
matt: prefer "Finish setup  5 quick steps". keeps it compact for banner width.
judy: copy + a11y tweak: progress indicator cannot rely on color alone. add text "1/5" and an aria-live update when a step is checked so screen readers get a clear update.
ricardo: for samples, research suggested "template" resonates more than "sample" — users expect a bootstrapped project. frontend: show 2 templates in the flyout (cards with short bullets) and link to full templates gallery on projects empty-state. clicking "Use template" should POST /api/projects with {template_id}.
anya: UX: we should avoid auto-opening the flyout for every new user; instead show compact banner initially and only open flyout when they click "Continue setup" or after they complete first step. this reduces surprise.
matt: dismissal behaviour: make the banner dismissible for 7 days, but surface a small launcher icon in header (aria-label="Open setup checklist") so people can reopen. also add subtle animation when the checklist reaches 100% and then hide the banner automatically with a success toast.
judy: keyboard microflow: when user tabs into banner, pressing Enter on the primary CTA should open flyout and focus first checklist checkbox. Escape should close flyout and return focus to the CTA. test with NVDA/VoiceOver.
ricardo: infra: optimistic-create for template flow: create locally visible project card while POST is inflight, then reconcile on response. fallback toast on 4xx/5xx. rate-limit our template endpoint so automated flows don't flood. bot-ci: scheduled e2e run for "onboard-banner" at 2025-09-10T01:00Z.
anya: accessibility QA checklist items (quick): keyboard trap, visible focus, aria-live for progress, non-color indicators for status, 4.5:1 button contrast, accessible labels on dismissal/reopen controls. i'll draft full checklist and post it.
matt: ok let's capture tasks: matt -> update mocks (compact + flyout + focus styles); judy -> a11y checklist + test matrix; ricardo -> prefs persistence + optimistic template create; anya -> copy polish and final handoff. will do 30m review tomorrow. thanks!
